_about: Dungeons and keys in the remake, for tools/rando/parity/dungeons.py. Read from the game files. dungeons: the remake area (Banc) of each OoTR dungeon, its save-data block DungeonInfo.<area> (IsGetMap, IsGetCompass, IsGetBossKey, SmallKeyNum: the chest nodes GameSystemActor.EventGetDungeon* credit the dungeon the player stands in), the remake's small keys and small-key doors (Obj_DoorChainLock pairs), whether it has a boss key, map and compass. vanilla_items: OoTR locations whose vanilla item differs from what the paired remake chest holds (data/rando/reconcile.json), where either side is a dungeon item; OoTR's item pool and its 'vanilla' placement are built from these, so they must describe the remake. kept_chests: {OoTR location: remake chest} for dungeon chests data/rando/chest_map.json keeps vanilla (KEY_COUNT_DIFFERS, low-confidence or 'absent' reconcile pairs) that this plugin paired with certainty (: positions, room contents, the GTG maze traced from its wall models, remake guides), plus the remake-only dungeon chests added as new OoTR locations (data/rando/logic/dungeons.json new_locations); the plugin keeps and writes them itself. A remake chest chest_map already plays may not appear here (checked on import). carriers: stand-in chest contents naming the dungeon item a chest's scene gives (never shown or added). scene_rows: the reused scene IDs (config/scene_rows.json) of the dungeon-item scene for small and big chests (the vanilla chest that used one keeps its item and plays the normal opening). scratch_string: a temporary save-data string (not saved, scrub flows only) the scene compares the chest contents with.

Bottom of the Well Front Left Fake Wall.why: remake chest holds a red rupee (2 keys / 2 doors)

Fire Temple Boulder Maze Side Room Chest.why: remake chest holds the Map (the lower boulder maze's big chest; same OoTR region and rule as the Lower chest)

Forest Temple Raised Island Courtyard Ch.why: remake east courtyard chest holds the Map (OoT's Map chest room has no chest)

Ganons Castle Light Trial Invisible Enem.why: remake chest holds a red rupee (1 key / 1 door)

Water Temple Central Pillar Chest.why: remake chest holds a red rupee (4 keys / 4 doors)

hideout_spots._about: Thieves' Hideout jail keys, matched to the remake's cells by room (story-gates and drops agree: 1 torch = carpenter 016 at y 110, 2 torches = 013 at y 102.5, 3 torches = 014, 4 torches = 015). entry_event: the cell guard's defeat entry GerudoFortress_DestroyGerudoThief0N in SageOfSpirit_RescueCarpenter (one call to GerudoThiefDropKey); keys: the two placements of that cell's key actor (SmallKeyForEvent_0N first); guard: the guard placement (its Drop__DropActor key, if any); flag: the key's own taken flag. All in Banc/GerudoFortress/GerudoFortress_Adult_Static.

fire_loop_door._about: Fire Temple boss-key loop door #17955 (Obj_FireTemple_Door_A_01, chain locks #07466/#63529): its unlocked state is the named Bool IsChainLockDoorOpen.<door instance hash> (DungeonDoor/DoorChainLock AI: QueryGetNonStructGameDataStruct 'IsChainLockDoorOpen'), default false, reset 24. Set true on a new file when small keys aren't keysanity, as OoTR's ROM patch removes this lock.
